Servicing FAQs

Frequently asked questions

Quick answers about service frequency, packages, timing, and value.

What are the benefits of doing servicing from Cars24?

Benefits include pickup and drop, technician support, process updates, quick turnaround, and service records within the Cars24 experience.

How frequently should you service your car?

A common recommendation is every 10,000 km for minor service and every 20,000 km for major service, adjusted for vehicle usage and manufacturer guidance.

What is the difference between standalone service and a service contract?

Standalone service covers one-time maintenance, while contracts package recurring servicing and can help with long-term cost predictability and warranty discipline.

How long does a car service take?

Minor services may be completed the same day for morning pickups, while major services can require a full day and next-day return.
